name: PM4Bench
description: PM4Bench is a parallel multilingual multi-modal multi-task benchmark designed for large vision language models (LVLMs). It features a parallel corpus across 10 languages, enabling fair cross-lingual comparisons, includes vision settings with embedded text and queries in images, and incorporates safety evaluations to address gaps in existing multilingual benchmarks.
reputation: A recent multilingual LVLM benchmark that is gaining attention for its parallel 10-language design and safety coverage, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes safety evaluations and focuses on cross-lingual and vision-language tasks; highlights OCR capability as key for performance disparities.
